tests.prompt: Publish all draft posts whose '_cli_ready' metadata is 'yes'. Leave pending posts, pages, and all other content untouched. The script must also succeed when rerun after the drafts have been published.
requirements: Use native WP-CLI commands for WordPress operations; discover IDs rather than assuming them.
tests.expected_behavior: The script satisfies these observable contracts: Only the two ready draft posts become published. Unrelated fixtures remain intact.
tests.reference_solution:
set -e
ids=$(wp post list --post_type=post --post_status=draft --meta_key=_cli_ready --meta_value=yes --format=ids)
if [ -n "$ids" ]; then wp post update $ids --post_status=publish; fi

tests.prompt: Permanently delete trashed posts in category 'cli-cleanup'. Preserve draft and published posts in that category, trashed pages, and trash outside it. Handle an empty matching set successfully; the grader runs the script twice on the same site.
requirements: Use native WP-CLI commands for WordPress operations; discover IDs rather than assuming them.
tests.expected_behavior: The script satisfies these observable contracts: Both matching posts are permanently removed and all other content survives. Unrelated fixtures remain intact.
tests.reference_solution:
set -e
ids=$(wp post list --post_type=post --post_status=trash --category_name=cli-cleanup --format=ids)
if [ -n "$ids" ]; then wp post delete $ids --force; fi

tests.prompt: Transfer posts authored by 'cli-old-writer' and marked '_cli_batch=handover' to 'cli-new-writer'. Include draft and published posts. Preserve their statuses, content, metadata, and categories. Leave the old writer's unmarked posts and similarly marked pages alone.
requirements: Use native WP-CLI commands for WordPress operations; discover IDs rather than assuming them.
tests.expected_behavior: The script satisfies these observable contracts: The selected posts change author without altering their other fields or relationships. Unrelated fixtures remain intact.
tests.reference_solution:
set -e
old=$(wp user get cli-old-writer --field=ID)
new=$(wp user get cli-new-writer --field=ID)
ids=$(wp post list --post_type=post --post_status=any --author="$old" --meta_key=_cli_batch --meta_value=handover --format=ids)
if [ -n "$ids" ]; then wp post update $ids --post_author="$new"; fi
exploit_solutions: wp post update $(wp post list --post_status=any --author=$(wp user get cli-old-writer --field=ID) --format=ids) --post_author=$(wp user get cli-new-writer --field=ID)
